content: vue-meta (latest stable 2.4.0, npm) was the Vue 2 standard for managing document head/meta tags but has had no stable release in ~4 years and never shipped Vue 3 support; a 3.0 alpha series exists but is unstable. For a small fixed-route static site (5 routes) with metadata already hardcoded in public/index.html per CLAUDE.md, adding vue-meta is unnecessary weight -- per-route document.title can be set directly in each view's mounted() hook, and social preview tags (og:) can stay hardcoded in index.html since this site's OG needs don't vary per-route (no dynamic content shared).
